verdict.rationale: Postman's own navigation lists an "API Catalog" and a "Private API Network", and its docs describe internal workspaces where teams share their work. This points to a first-party internal discovery surface. However, the evidence is only a navigation-menu mention, with no documentation of how a platform team publishes APIs to the private network or how other teams discover and consume them. missing for 10: documented publishing workflow for an internal catalog/portal, discovery and consumption features for consuming teams, access controls specific to the catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can publish an internal catalog or portal where teams discover and consume our APIs
